# this = character. One CX|gear line per equipped battle gear artifact (PROTOCOL.md §16.2).
ck3xbl_emit_cx_gear_effect = {
	every_equipped_character_artifact = {
		limit = { OR = { artifact_slot_type = ck3xbl_weapon artifact_slot_type = ck3xbl_head artifact_slot_type = ck3xbl_body artifact_slot_type = ck3xbl_hands artifact_slot_type = ck3xbl_legs artifact_slot_type = ck3xbl_cape artifact_slot_type = ck3xbl_horse } }
		if = { limit = { has_artifact_modifier = ck3xbl_item_1_modifier } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|gear|ck3xbl_main|aserai_sword_1_t2" }
		else_if = { limit = { has_artifact_modifier = ck3xbl_item_2_modifier } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|gear|ck3xbl_main|aserai_sword_3_t3" }
		else_if = { limit = { has_artifact_modifier = ck3xbl_item_3_modifier } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|gear|ck3xbl_main|aserai_sword_4_t4" }
		else_if = { limit = { has_artifact_modifier = ck3xbl_item_4_modifier } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|gear|ck3xbl_main|aserai_noble_sword_1_t5" }

# this = character. Fills the six armory offers (variables ck3xbl_offer_<n>, _gold, _prestige); prices with the era factor.
ck3xbl_armory_restock_effect = {
	ck3xbl_roll_shop_main_own_effect = yes
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_1 value = scope:ck3xbl_pick }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_1_gold value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_pick_gold multiply = ck3xbl_era_price_factor round = yes } }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_1_prestige value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_pick_prestige multiply = ck3xbl_era_price_factor round = yes } }
	ck3xbl_roll_shop_gear_own_effect = yes
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_2 value = scope:ck3xbl_pick }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_2_gold value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_pick_gold multiply = ck3xbl_era_price_factor round = yes } }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_2_prestige value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_pick_prestige multiply = ck3xbl_era_price_factor round = yes } }
	ck3xbl_roll_shop_armor_own_effect = yes
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_3 value = scope:ck3xbl_pick }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_3_gold value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_pick_gold multiply = ck3xbl_era_price_factor round = yes } }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_3_prestige value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_pick_prestige multiply = ck3xbl_era_price_factor round = yes } }
	ck3xbl_roll_shop_horse_own_effect = yes
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_4 value = scope:ck3xbl_pick }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_4_gold value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_pick_gold multiply = ck3xbl_era_price_factor round = yes } }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_4_prestige value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_pick_prestige multiply = ck3xbl_era_price_factor round = yes } }
	ck3xbl_roll_shop_all_own_effect = yes
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_5 value = scope:ck3xbl_pick }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_5_gold value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_pick_gold multiply = ck3xbl_era_price_factor round = yes } }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_5_prestige value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_pick_prestige multiply = ck3xbl_era_price_factor round = yes } }
	ck3xbl_roll_shop_all_any_effect = yes
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_6 value = scope:ck3xbl_pick }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_6_gold value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_pick_gold multiply = ck3xbl_era_price_factor round = yes } }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_offer_6_prestige value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_pick_prestige multiply = ck3xbl_era_price_factor round = yes } }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_armory_stocked value = yes years = 2 }
}

# this = character. Buys armory offer $N$ (the option checked the money): pays, creates the artifact, clears the offer.
ck3xbl_armory_buy_effect = {
	remove_short_term_gold = var:ck3xbl_offer_$N$_gold
	if = {
		limit = { var:ck3xbl_offer_$N$_prestige > 0 }
		add_prestige = { value = var:ck3xbl_offer_$N$_prestige multiply = -1 }
	}
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_pick value = var:ck3xbl_offer_$N$ }
	ck3xbl_create_item_effect = yes
	remove_variable = ck3xbl_offer_$N$
	remove_variable = ck3xbl_offer_$N$_gold
	remove_variable = ck3xbl_offer_$N$_prestige
}

# this = AI ruler. Equips one of its knights (or itself) with an item it can comfortably pay for (PROTOCOL.md §16.5).
ck3xbl_ai_outfit_effect = {
	random_list = {
		40 = { ck3xbl_roll_shop_main_own_effect = yes }
		20 = { ck3xbl_roll_shop_gear_own_effect = yes }
		30 = { ck3xbl_roll_shop_armor_own_effect = yes }
		10 = { ck3xbl_roll_shop_horse_own_effect = yes }
	}
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_ai_gold value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_pick_gold multiply = ck3xbl_era_price_factor round = yes } }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_ai_need_gold value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_ai_gold multiply = 3 } }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_ai_need_prestige value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_pick_prestige multiply = 3 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			gold >= scope:ck3xbl_ai_need_gold
			prestige >= scope:ck3xbl_ai_need_prestige
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = scope:ck3xbl_ai_gold
		if = { limit = { scope:ck3xbl_pick_prestige > 0 } add_prestige = { value = scope:ck3xbl_pick_prestige multiply = -1 } }
		random_list = {
			60 = {
				trigger = { any_knight = { is_alive = yes } }
				random_knight = { ck3xbl_create_item_effect = yes }
			}
			40 = { ck3xbl_create_item_effect = yes }
		}
	}
}

	ck3xbl_create_item_effect = yes
}
